sloka: एतस्मिन् आश्रमे वासम् चिरम् तु न समर्थये ।तम् एवम् उक्त्वा उपरमम् रामः संध्याम् उपागमत् ॥३-७-२२॥
transliteration: etasmin āśrame vāsam ciram tu na samarthaye ।tam evam uktvā uparamam rāmaḥ saṁdhyām upāgamat ॥3-7-22॥

translations.english: Rama stopped with this. And then the evening drew to a close. Offering his evening oblation, he arranged for his stay along with Sita and Lakshmana in the delightful hermitage of Sutikshna.
